data.one_liner: Dart client-side API package for the TMDB (The Movie Database) API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client library to interact with TMDB.org API endpoints such as trending movies, tv shows, watch providers, and details. Allows configuring console logs, custom Dio instances, default languages, and interceptors.
use_when: You need to fetch movie or TV show data from The Movie Database in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want a pre-built wrapper over the TMDB REST API using Dio.
avoid_when: You are building an app that does not require movie or media database integrations.
You prefer to write raw HTTP requests directly without a third-party TMDB wrapper.
strengths: Supports a wide range of TMDB v3 endpoints including trending, TV series, videos, and watch providers.
Built-in logging presets and options for custom Dio instances and interceptors.
weaknesses: Dependent on a specific third-party API wrapper which may lag behind official TMDB API updates.
data.setup_notes: Requires an API key and/or apiReadAccessTokenv4 from The Movie Database (TMDB.org).

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making direct HTTP requests to the TMDB API using a robust HTTP client without relying on a dedicated wrapper.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard Dart http package for custom REST API consumption.
